_comment: Price and cost class of each AI provider / model, read by python/llm/ai_gate.py (the AI budget gate).
class: free | local | paid | unknown. A provider or model missing here is unknown, and unknown is treated as paid.
inputPerMTok / outputPerMTok: price per million tokens in `currency`. null means the price is unknown:
a paid call with an unknown price is refused whenever the budget is not 0 too, because its cost cannot be checked.
Fill a price only from the provider's own price page, and record that page in `source` and the day in `checkedAt`.
model "*" matches every model of the provider; an exact model entry wins over "*".
A local entry counts as local only while its base URL points at this machine or a private network.

entries.source: Runs on this server; no per-token bill
Built-in canned answers; no model is called

entries.note: Claude Code CLI on the owner's subscription; usage counts against a paid plan
